title: PGCIL Diploma Trainee Admit Card 2026 Out
summary: Power Grid Corporation of India Limited (PGCIL) has released a notification on its official website for the recruitment of Engineer Trainee (Electrical, Civil & Computer Science) posts. This recruitment is for 319 positions. The PGCIL application form has started on 03 November 2026, and candidates can apply until 18 November 2026. The minimum age is N/A & the maximum age is 28 years as on 11 May 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for the PGCIL Engineer Trainee Recruitment 2026 provided below. ( Advt. No. CC/04/2026 )
qualification: Candidates must have a full-time B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc. (Engineering) degree in Electrical, Electrical (Power), Electrical and Electronics, Power Systems Engineering, or Power Engineering (Electrical) with at least 60% marks or equivalent CGPA from a recognized university/institute. A GATE 2027 Score Card is also required.
